name: com.millitool/skills
title: MilliTool
description: Find coding-agent skills by task and inspect source previews through MilliTool's free MCP server.

tools.name: recommend_skills
tools.description: Find skills for a task or technology stack. Returns ranked candidates, indexed source commits, compatibility hints and installation suggestions. Does not install or run code.

tools.name: get_skill_content
tools.description: Get indexed metadata and content preview for a skill_id returned by recommend_skills. Includes pinned source URL and install suggestion; preview may be incomplete. Does not fetch arbitrary URLs or execute code.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List the indexed source repositories and current skill counts.

tools.name: browse_categories
tools.description: List normalized category names and slugs. Pass a slug to recommend_skills to filter results.
